newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's assigns A3 to NEC's Euro MTN programme.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns A3 to NEC's Euro MTN programme.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Tuesday it had assigend its A3 rating to the $2 billion Euro Medium-Term Note (MTN) programme of NEC Corp and its wholly owned financial subsidiary, NEC Industries (U.K.) Plc (NEC U.K.).

Moody's said the continued improvement in operating results and financial fundamentals by Japan's leading semiconductor and telecommunications equipment maker should support an upward pressure on the rating.

The rating agency said the A3 rating was based on a keepwell agreement and a "Deed Poll" between NEC and NEC U.K. It said the Deed Poll strengthens and clarifies the rights and benefits of the noteholders under the keepwell agreement.
